corpus.note: WFA-0025 academic-sweep artifact is absent on this worktree. The adapter translates a local corpus covering the protocol families named in WFA-0025 (debate, Delphi, self-consistency, role committees) plus a deliberate underspecified control and a scoring-unpinned partial. These are original fixtures, not copyrighted paper reprints.

evidence.claim: The deliberate underspecified fixture is refused as UNDERSPECIFIED and names participant_count, turn_structure, stopping_rule, and scoring as parameters the author must supply.
Every FILLED IR field on the translated papers quotes a source sentence present in the fixture; unquoted fields are MISSING.
An independent cue-scan lists the parameters each paper specifies. No adapter fill of a cued field is absent from that list. A planted participant_count fill on the underspecified paper is caught.

falsifiable_answer: 4 papers translated with quote-anchored IR fields; 2 refused UNDERSPECIFIED. The underspecified control names all four required parameters; the partial control names only scoring. Independent reader found 0 hallucinated defaults.

independent_reader.mechanism: cue-presence scan over an independent sentence split; does not import adapter extractors

negative_controls.description: Vague discussion prose must be UNDERSPECIFIED; grafting the four pinned sentences must flip it to TRANSLATED; stripping them from a specified paper must flip it back.
A planted participant_count fill on the underspecified paper must appear in hallucinated_fills.
A paper that pins three required parameters but says only 'quality is assessed' must refuse and name scoring only.
